localChanges: Pressing F5 during a game opened the Trade Report and, on top of it, a box asking whether you wanted to reload the page. It just opens the Trade Report now. F5 on the main menu, and Ctrl+R (Cmd+R on a Mac) at any time, still check before reloading (#10).

W (wait) is meant to put a unit to one side and come back to it once everything else has moved, but it only ever flicked to the next unit, and the one you skipped could turn straight back up. A unit you wait now goes to the back of the queue and returns after every other unit has had its turn, longest-waiting first. Waiting your last unit simply keeps it selected (#10).
